name: @mkusaka/gain
description: Run gh with a GitHub App installation token, with keys and tokens in macOS Keychain.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync('dist/gain.js', require('node:module').stripTypeScriptTypes(fs.readFileSync('gain.ts', 'utf8')))"
